title.zh: DOJ Seeks to Seize $61M in Iran Oil Funds From Binance Accounts It Vouched For - BeInCrypto
title.en: DOJ Seeks to Seize $61M in Iran Oil Funds From Binance Accounts It Vouched For - BeInCrypto

current_state.zh: The U.S. Department of Justice is seeking to seize roughly $61 million in Iran-linked oil funds held in Binance accounts that the exchange had previously vouched for, highlighting sanctions-compliance exposure for major crypto platforms.
current_state.en: The U.S. Department of Justice is seeking to seize roughly $61 million in Iran-linked oil funds held in Binance accounts that the exchange had previously vouched for, highlighting sanctions-compliance exposure for major crypto platforms.
